name: product-demos
summary: Installs the selected upstream Product Demos domains through owned AAP templates.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reuses Product Demos base resources and reconciles selected owned domain templates.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before domain setup when the cluster, AAP, bootstrap project, or required execution environment is unavailable.

readiness: Selected owned domain templates and base resources are available in AAP.

security.secret_storage: Domain-specific credentials remain separate from shared Product Demos setup.
security.network_trust: AAP and pinned upstream content use configured trust controls.
security.external_actions: Templates are imported; customer infrastructure is not provisioned automatically.
